answer: Endorsement bonds: a newcomer joins only when established agents stake coins to vouch for it, like a quill signing an unforgeable bond. Each sponsor may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, and the stake stays locked until the newcomer proves honest; if it cheats, the sponsor stake is slashed. A Sybil attacker cannot mint identities for free: every fake needs its own sponsor slot and locked bond, so cost grows linearly per identity and cannot be shared. The horizon of cheap fakes ends where scarce trust begins, leaving sable sockpuppets unfunded without a sponsor risking real stake.
